reasoning: DIRECTION UP, and the GAP owns essentially all of it. (1) E's OWN NAMED FLIP CONDITION FIRED. E emitted monday_bias DOWN-SMALL and wrote that the one thing that flips it is a weekend heat ADD. model_disagreement asof 2026-06-28T23:59Z, 16/16 metros, coverage 1.0, both models: mav_gw_cdd 10.076 -> 14.815 (+4.74), met_gw_cdd 9.441 -> 13.612 (+4.17); D+1 is hotter still (mav 10.548 -> 15.933, met 8.632 -> 13.935). The largest single-session CDD step anywhere else in my slice is +2.21 (0623->0624). weather_forecast.forecast_gw_cdd carries the same 14.815 and weather.gw_cdd the same 14.8 - though these are all the MAV run, so MET is the one genuinely independent corroboration. Per _information_clock the MET Sunday 12Z cycle posts ~15:30-16:30 ET, BEFORE the 18:00 ET reopen, so the reopen prices +4.17 at minimum; the MAV 18Z posts ~21:30-22:30 ET, after the reopen but well before my 08:00 open, so it lands inside the same gap window and ACCELERATES it. Two consecutive hot cycles = magnitude.weekend_gap_delivery's fresh/accelerating arm on the letter, not the already-priced arm. Forecast-model derived, so immune to the nws_temp partial-fetch tail defect. (2) GAP OWNERSHIP, magnitude.block_gap_ownership strict order, each rung tested against a measured quantity. Rung 1 ANCHOR_STRUCTURAL: the dead-sponsor CALENDAR trigger is live (squeeze_watch unwind_watch true, sessions_since_prompt_expiry 1, NGN26 expired 0626 confirmed by flow_calendar is_expiry_day true) but the arm requires premium STRANDED IN THE FRONT and the front was at a DISCOUNT - contract_structure calendar_front_settle 3.233 vs calendar_next_settle 3.276, calendar_front_next_spread -0.043 cheapening (chg_3d -0.021), curve_regime contango on every day of the block, squeeze_watch days_to_calendar_front_expiry_live 21. DECLINE. (Caveat: that spread is the frozen 0619 vintage and frozen_structure_stale says front-keyed fields are not decision-legit; the decline therefore rests on the contango regime plus the absence of any evidence in-slice that the front ever carried premium, not on the stale number alone.) Rung 1b positioning_saturation_turn: limb (a) fails (NYMEX MM 1y pctile 29.25, needs <=~12) and limb (d) fails (storage phase inject, needs withdraw). DECLINE. Rung 2 WEEKEND_CYCLE_WEATHER OWNS IT, fresh arm. chain_drift never reached. (3) GAP SIZE, derived not fitted. The fresh arm's +1500..+2500 is winter-measured; vol_regime n0_net_sigma_10 = 614 and n0_range_pctile 18.3 make that 2.4-4.1 sigma, implausible. Two independent derivations: FUNDAMENTAL - +4.7 gw_cdd is roughly +4-5 Bcf/d of incremental power burn while it holds, and h1 > h0 says it holds at least into D+1, so ~20-28 Bcf of balance improvement against a storage vs_5yr surplus of +112 and a loose 81 Bcf consensus three days out; that dents but does not erase the cushion, worth ~2-5 cents = +200..+500. VOL-SCALED - the fresh-shot arm rescaled by regime sigma lands higher, +700..+1200. daytype.thin_session_range_invariance argues against under-sizing a 194-trade reopen (price per unit of flow rises as participation falls, so excursions survive), and daytype.monday_weekend_gap's honest record is that fresh-shot Monday gaps are UNDER-forecast 3 for 3 (1020, 0118, 0125) - all winter, all in higher-sigma regimes. Offsets: nuclear_outages chg_1d -940.7 MW and chg_7d -1443.1 MW (capacity RETURNING, bearish burn at the margin), and cot.ice.ld1 managed_money_net_chg_wow -21,905 at the 2.83rd 1y pctile, a third consecutive week of liquidation (-16,542, -30,467, -21,905). Settled at +480, about 0.78 sigma and 43% of n0_range_10_mean 1126. Band +200..+850. (4) THE SESSION GIVES A LITTLE BACK. selector.divergence_resolution's trigger is exactly satisfied - a storage/S3-bearish DOWN angle against a weather-add UP angle inside a confirmed S1-void injection regime (near-window normals base ~0.2 gw HDD, well under 20; storage phase inject; consensus 81 Bcf building on a +112 surplus). Its gate (a), near-window max forecast gw-HDD vs 16.4, is INAPPLICABLE not failed: the ladders are HDD-only in a block whose driver runs CDD 7.8 -> 18.9, and reading its unreachability as a bearish verdict is the artifact the auditor named. Its gate (b), session_b_share >= ~0.50, is the play's own declared physical-neutrality bar, so per the b_share_basis_note it must be read TWO-SIDED: 0626 = 0.504 and the 0628 stub = 0.521, both clear (on the biased original series they read 0.472 and 0.424 and would fail - the exact S108 trap). With gate (a) unevaluable and gate (b) marginal, the play's own conclusion is that the add owns AT MOST the single reopen gap it enters on and earns NO intraday day-lean, with the session net reverting to the S3 bleed. That is an independent arrival at the same split. monday.catchup_window_tilt_gate's 0406 precedent says the same thing in its own words: a sub-threshold shoulder add prices ONCE in the reopen gap and then the tape reasserts. Sized at -155, roughly a third of the gap. (5) THE SESSION IS NOT DEEPLY NEGATIVE, for two reasons. weekend.carry_realization_flip: the driver's peak is still AHEAD of Monday (h1 CDD 15.933 > h0 14.815), so Monday CARRIES rather than sells the news - this is not a realization fade. And monday.overnight_headfake_into_catchup does NOT fire: the 0628 stub's flow CONFIRMS an up gap (session_signed_flow +13, two-sided 0.521, phase two-sided 0.513/0.529/0.600 rising into the close), and the play's own caveat says that on a Monday whose overnight gap confirms the D-1 tilt the gap is real and it stands down. So the 08-10 catch-up window ratifies rather than reverses; the fade is the S3-bearish complex reasserting later, not a head-fake unwinding. (6) THE 0626 BIG-PRINT FLIP IS ROLL MECHANICS AND I VERIFY IT INDEPENDENTLY OF A. flow_calendar.is_expiry_day is TRUE on 0626 - NGN26's expiry day - and the scored leg is the deferred NGQ26, so every roll and every expiring-long transfer prints as an aggressor BUY on the leg being measured. Three price-free confirmations. (i) THE DISPOSITIVE ONE: session_signed_flow FELL from +1,956 on 0625 to +871 on 0626 on the day big_print_b_share supposedly flipped from 0.499 to 0.783. Less aggregate net buying on the day the blocks turned buy. Decomposing, at any plausible big-print size threshold (210 prints) the block cohort alone contributes several thousand lots of net buy, which forces the residual non-block tape to be a clear net SELLER on Friday - I state that sign as robust and decline to claim its magnitude, since the big-print size threshold is not served. (ii) session_b_share_two_sided did not move (0.509 -> 0.504, marginally lower). (iii) unsided_volume_frac collapsed 0.133 -> 0.063, which is what a large sided-block cohort does mechanically. Also consistent: n_trades FELL 51,708 -> 48,072 while volume_lots ROSE 119,374 -> 121,487 (average print size up) and leg_count_150 was flat 38 -> 37 while big_prints_n nearly doubled 122 -> 210. So flow.price_free_absorption_proxy's precondition is met on the letter (positive session flow, 210 prints, guard-clean) and its accumulation-confirmed reading would be BULLISH - I stand it down anyway as contaminated, because the input it reads is a mechanical roll rather than a directional decision. That cuts against my own direction call, which is why I say it. (7) CHAIN STATE, per boundary.chain_label_must_track_realized_cum. I state the inherited cum on the only basis I can measure: cumulative session_signed_flow from the 0619 anchor = -1,353 -3,717 -1,990 +311 +1,956 +871 +13 = -3,909 lots, still net SOLD from the anchor. The price cum_from_anchor is masked and E honestly refused to invent it; I do not invent it either. On the flow basis the chain is UP, turned 0624 (-3,717, -1,990, +311, +1,956, +871), age 4 counting the Sunday stub - and critically NOT at a cum extreme, since the block has not yet bought back the anchor's net selling. So daytype.monday_weekend_gap's FADE arm (a gap jumping with a mature swing to a fresh cum-extreme) does not apply; the EXTEND-at-a-turn arm is the closer read, discounted for a turn that is four sessions old rather than fresh. (8) I DEMOTE ONE OF E's INPUTS ON PROVENANCE. E cited cash_basis chg_3d -0.212 as bearish. That block is masked_one_shot with vintage_asof 20260619, hh_spot_gas_day 2026-06-16 - roughly thirteen days stale at my open, and frozen alongside contract_structure, options_surface and vol_regime. It was legitimate at E's decision point and it is not legitimate at mine. E's other bearish limbs (surplus 112, consensus 81, contango, spent covering) I keep. E's -0.5 CDD model cut was real for its vintage (forecast_run_delta_cdd -0.500 on 0626) and has simply been overwritten by a +4.7 level move E could not have seen.
